0022600197.text: The Detroit Pistons (6-2, first in the Central) host the Los Angeles Lakers (7-2, first in the Pacific) in the Pistons' ninth game of the season, with Detroit coming off a loss while Los Angeles is riding a three-game winning streak. Detroit will be without Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) and Isaiah Joe (hip bruise), both listed as out. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won both meetings in 2025-26 and took the most recent one 113-110 in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
